AIInsightsPanel requests an insight from functions/v1/openrouter-proxy when a role's home dashboard mounts. A six-hour cache now serves repeat mounts, but every tour session is a fresh browser context with empty storage, so each one still makes the cold call — and 24 sessions within a few minutes exhaust the free-tier quota, after which every later request in the run answers 429. The status varies with the live project's state (429 while rate-limited; 404/500 seen on earlier runs), so the signature matches any status for that endpoint. This is a real limit worth respecting rather than a pure harness artifact: the same burst from real users would rate-limit them too. Delete this entry once the call is gated behind explicit consent (SEC-06) and its failure is surfaced as a four-state error region instead of a console line.
